rect-lamps.name: ceiling right of the lamps
rect-lamps.light: No direct light: the ceiling panels send their light down. Bounce light from the floor and the walls that the panels light.

rect-lamps.name: floor in the middle
rect-lamps.light: Direct light of the ceiling panels; bounce light from the walls and the ceiling.

rect-lamps.name: left wall above the windows
rect-lamps.light: Direct light of the ceiling panels at a grazing angle; bounce light from the floor.

rect-lamps.name: far end wall
rect-lamps.light: Direct light of the far panels; bounce light from the floor and the side walls.

sunlit-nose.name: ceiling cloud box of ter-fe63
sunlit-nose.light: No direct light (ter-fe63): neither the sun nor a panel lights the ceiling. Bounce light from the sunlit floor patch and sill at the nose, and from the floor that the panels light.

sunlit-nose.name: sunlit floor before the nose wall
sunlit-nose.light: Direct sunlight through the nose window, and the far panels; bounce light from the nose wall and the side walls.

sunlit-nose.name: near floor
sunlit-nose.light: Direct light of the ceiling panels; bounce light from the walls, the ceiling and, far away, the sunlit patch.

sunlit-nose.name: left wall
sunlit-nose.light: Direct light of the ceiling panels at a grazing angle; bounce light from the floor, with the sunlit patch far down the hall.

cabin-light-cabin.name: floor with sun stripes
cabin-light-cabin.light: Direct sunlight through the side and roof windows on the stripes, no direct light in the shadows between them; bounce light from the sunlit floor, walls and frame; the sky through the windows.

cabin-light-cabin.name: floor beside the right wall, mostly in shade
cabin-light-cabin.light: No direct light in most of it (dark in the direct-light still); one sun stripe crosses its lower left corner. Bounce light from the sunlit floor stripes and the right wall; the sky through the windows.

cabin-light-cabin.name: sunlit roof beams
cabin-light-cabin.light: Direct sunlight through the roof windows; bounce light from the floor and the walls; the sky.

exit-cabin.name: floor in the middle
exit-cabin.light: Direct light of the four pillar lamps and the two ceiling lamps, with the frame's shadows; bounce light from the walls and the frame; the blue light outside the windows.

exit-cabin.name: right wall below the windows
exit-cabin.light: Direct light of the right pillar lamps; bounce light from the floor; the blue light outside the windows above it.

exit-cabin.name: ceiling between the beams
exit-cabin.light: Direct light of the two ceiling lamps; bounce light from the floor and the walls.

exit-cabin.name: side of the tilted blue crate
exit-cabin.light: Direct light of the right pillar lamps; bounce light from the floor.

bay-sunbeam.name: sunlit patch at the upper left
bay-sunbeam.light: Direct sunlight through the slot (the bright patch of the direct-light still) and the left bay lamp below it; bounce light from the back wall and the floor.

bay-sunbeam.name: back wall below the slot
bay-sunbeam.light: Weak direct light of the two bay lamps; bounce light from the sunlit patch and the floor; space through the slot above.

bay-sunbeam.name: floor
bay-sunbeam.light: Weak direct light of the bay lamps; bounce light from the sunlit patch and the walls.

bay-sunbeam.name: right wall
bay-sunbeam.light: Direct light of the right bay lamp near it; bounce light from the sunlit patch across the bay and from the floor.
